body:
This is a report on behalf of a friend I know.  His first experiment with mushrooms was a bad one.  He only ate half of his eighth and had extreme feelings paranoia and fear.  He was on Prozac at the time of ingestion and believed that the combination of the two drugs gave him the negative experience.
